title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #6

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A classmate is sitting alone and looks sad. What should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Laugh at them
   B. Sit with them and kindly ask what is wrong
   C. Tell others to avoid them
   D. Ignore them

2. Which thought is likely to lead to a wrong action? (1 mark)
   A. I will help my friend
   B. I will thank my teacher
   C. I will share my lunch
   D. I want to take what is not mine

3. Which is a result of a bad choice such as fighting? (1 mark)
   A. More friends
   B. Better marks
   C. Injury and punishment
   D. Getting a prize

4. Which of these is part of the extended family? (1 mark)
   A. An uncle
   B. A classmate
   C. A bus driver
   D. A shopkeeper

5. What is a good rule when you are alone with people? (1 mark)
   A. Be careful and stay in open places
   B. Share private pictures
   C. Accept lifts from strangers
   D. Go to hidden places

6. What does 1 Corinthians 6:19 say our bodies are? (1 mark)
   A. Property of strangers
   B. Machines
   C. Toys
   D. Temples of the Holy Spirit

7. Which verse says that there is no one holy like the Lord? (1 mark)
   A. Galatians 5:22
   B. Isaiah 49:16
   C. 1 Samuel 2:2
   D. Luke 1:37

8. What position did Pharaoh give Joseph? (1 mark)
   A. Soldier
   B. Priest
   C. Second in command over Egypt
   D. Shepherd

9. Which verse in Luke says that John would go before the Lord to prepare His way? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 15:8
   B. Luke 1:76
   C. Luke 19:5
   D. Luke 7:14

10. How did Jesus feel when He saw the widow? (1 mark)
   A. He was afraid
   B. He was angry
   C. He was bored
   D. His heart went out to her

11. How did the crowd react? (1 mark)
   A. They argued
   B. They were filled with awe and praised God
   C. They laughed
   D. They left in anger

12. To reconcile means to: (1 mark)
   A. Shout
   B. Become friends again after a quarrel
   C. Run away
   D. Fight

13. What does the seed grow into? (1 mark)
   A. A large tree
   B. A river
   C. A small flower
   D. A rock

14. What does a seed need to grow? (1 mark)
   A. Soil, water and light
   B. Nothing
   C. Only sand
   D. Only noise

15. What does repentance do? (1 mark)
   A. It pushes us away from God
   B. It makes us proud
   C. It has no effect
   D. It draws us close to Christ

16. What did Jesus say a person must be born of? (1 mark)
   A. Bread and wine
   B. Earth and sky
   C. Water and the Spirit
   D. Fire and wind

17. What did Joseph do when he was tempted? (1 mark)
   A. Agreed
   B. Refused and ran away
   C. Stayed to argue
   D. Told everyone

18. Which of these helps us to overcome lying? (1 mark)
   A. Exaggerating
   B. Hiding things
   C. Blaming others
   D. Admitting mistakes quickly

19. What should you do if you broke a cup? (1 mark)
   A. Blame a sibling
   B. Run away
   C. Hide it
   D. Tell the truth and say sorry

20. If someone says they love you but hurts you, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Tell a trusted adult
   B. Ignore it
   C. Keep it secret
   D. Hurt them

21. Why is the church called the house of God? (1 mark)
   A. It is a shop
   B. It is a farm
   C. It is a holy place for worship
   D. It is a school

22. About how many people were baptised that day? (1 mark)
   A. Three thousand
   B. Thirty
   C. Three
   D. Three hundred

23. Who preached to the crowd at Pentecost? (1 mark)
   A. Stephen
   B. Peter
   C. Judas
   D. Thomas

24. In which city were believers first called Christians? (1 mark)
   A. Jericho
   B. Jerusalem
   C. Antioch
   D. Nazareth

25. Who was watching when Stephen was stoned? (1 mark)
   A. A young man named Saul
   B. Peter
   C. Thomas
   D. Balaam

26. What do we ask when we say "forgive us our debts"? (1 mark)
   A. Money
   B. Bread
   C. A gift
   D. Forgiveness of our sins

27. How can we grow the fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Only watch TV
   B. Pray, read the Bible and practise
   C. Only sleep
   D. Ignore the Bible

28. What can help you to build self-control? (1 mark)
   A. Bad company
   B. Keeping busy with good activities
   C. Being idle
   D. Ignoring rules

29. Which media can defile a child? (1 mark)
   A. Bible stories
   B. Educational programmes
   C. Gospel songs
   D. Violent and ungodly movies

30. What does Philippians 4:8 encourage us to think about? (1 mark)
   A. Whatever is unkind
   B. Whatever is false
   C. Whatever hurts
   D. Whatever is true, pure and lovely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain the meaning of "Give us today our daily bread". (3 marks)

32. Where were believers first called Christians? (2 marks)

33. Explain what "born again" means. (2 marks)

34. Explain how Ephesians 4:25 can be applied by a child in the classroom. (5 marks)

35. Explain why obedience is important at home and at school, and when a child should not obey. (5 marks)

36. Explain what the healing of Bartimaeus teaches about Jesus. (3 marks)

37. Describe four ways in which God shows that He is a loving Father. (4 marks)

38. Explain how a child can show faith in God when they or a family member is sick. (5 marks)

39. State three lessons from the story of Zacchaeus. (3 marks)

40. Write John 3:16 in your own words and explain what it teaches. (4 marks)

41. Explain why Zechariah was unable to speak. (3 marks)

42. Explain what a child should do if a stranger contacts them online and why. (5 marks)

43. Describe how the boy in John 6 shows that small gifts can do great things. (4 marks)

44. State two lessons from the story of Stephen. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Sit with them and kindly ask what is wrong
   Kindness and listening help a sad friend.

2. D — I want to take what is not mine
   Wanting to take what belongs to others leads to stealing.

3. C — Injury and punishment
   Fighting often brings pain, trouble and lost friendships.

4. A — An uncle
   Uncles are relatives outside the nuclear family.

5. A — Be careful and stay in open places
   Safe places and caution protect you.

6. D — Temples of the Holy Spirit
   The verse teaches that the body is a temple of the Holy Spirit.

7. C — 1 Samuel 2:2
   1 Samuel 2:2 declares God's holiness.

8. C — Second in command over Egypt
   Joseph was put in charge of Egypt, next to Pharaoh.

9. B — Luke 1:76
   Luke 1:76-79 speaks about John's task.

10. D — His heart went out to her
   Luke 7:13 says He had compassion.

11. B — They were filled with awe and praised God
   They said, "A great prophet has appeared."

12. B — Become friends again after a quarrel
   Reconcile means to make peace.

13. A — A large tree
   The seed grew and became a tree.

14. A — Soil, water and light
   Seeds need soil, water and light.

15. D — It draws us close to Christ
   Repenting means turning to God for a new start.

16. C — Water and the Spirit
   John 3:5 says this.

17. B — Refused and ran away
   He left his cloak and ran out of the house.

18. D — Admitting mistakes quickly
   Admitting mistakes builds truthfulness.

19. D — Tell the truth and say sorry
   Honesty and apology are right.

20. A — Tell a trusted adult
   Love is never hurtful.

21. C — It is a holy place for worship
   Believers meet there to worship God.

22. A — Three thousand
   Acts 2:41.

23. B — Peter
   Peter spoke boldly.

24. C — Antioch
   Acts 11:26.

25. A — A young man named Saul
   Acts 7:58.

26. D — Forgiveness of our sins
   Debts stands for sins.

27. B — Pray, read the Bible and practise
   Practice and prayer help.

28. B — Keeping busy with good activities
   Good activities help.

29. D — Violent and ungodly movies
   Harmful media can affect the mind.

30. D — Whatever is true, pure and lovely
   Philippians 4:8.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: We ask God to give us what we need each day, such as food. We depend on Him and we thank Him for what we have.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for needs, 1 for food or daily, 1 for thanks or dependence.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: Antioch (Acts 11:26).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Antioch and 1 for reference or the meaning.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: A new spiritual birth, a fresh start given by God through the Holy Spirit.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for new life and 1 for the Holy Spirit.

34. (5 marks)
   Answer: Put off falsehood and speak truthfully because we are all members of one body. A child should not cheat, should admit mistakes, should not blame others, and should tell the teacher what really happened.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the verse meaning, 1 for not cheating, 1 for admitting mistakes, 1 for not blaming, 1 for telling the truth kindly.

35. (5 marks)
   Answer: Obedience brings peace at home, safety and learning at school. It pleases God. A child should not obey instructions that are unsafe or hurt them or others. In that case they should say no and tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for home peace, 1 for school learning, 1 for pleasing God, 1 for not obeying harmful instructions, 1 for telling a trusted adult.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus has power over sickness. He cares about the poor and those who suffer. He responds to faith.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: He gives life, food, water and air; gives families; forgives when we are sorry; knows us by name; sent Jesus to save us.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.

38. (5 marks)
   Answer: Pray, believe that God cares, ask trusted adults, go to a clinic or hospital for treatment, thank God for help, and continue to trust. Faith does not mean ignoring doctors.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for prayer, 1 for belief in God's care, 1 for seeking treatment, 1 for thanks, 1 for continuing to trust.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus loves everyone, even those others reject; repentance means changing and putting things right; we should be honest with money and share with the poor.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: God loved the world so much that He gave His only Son so that everyone who believes in Him will not be lost but will have eternal life. It teaches God's love and the way to eternal life.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's love, 1 for giving Jesus, 1 for believing, 1 for eternal life.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: He doubted the angel's message. The angel said that he would be silent until the baby was born because he did not believe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for doubt, 1 for the angel's words, 1 for silence until it happened.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: They should not reply, should close the chat, should tell a parent or teacher, and can call 116. Strangers may pretend to be someone else and may want to harm the child. Telling a trusted adult keeps the child safe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not replying, 1 for closing, 1 for telling an adult, 1 for the helpline, 1 for the reason.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: The boy shared five loaves and two fish. Jesus used them to feed a large crowd. This shows that a small gift given willingly can help many.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the boy sharing, 1 for the food, 1 for Jesus feeding many, 1 for the lesson.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Be brave; forgive; trust God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
